subject: DPIA evidence: annotated dataflow ledger & subprocessor extracts
messages:
From: Sarah Tucker <sarah.tucker@mednet.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: DPIA support + Art 28/30 ledger extracts

Hi Chloe,

We have an upcoming regulatory readiness review at MedNet covering our integration with Redwood (target window: week of Dec 7). The auditor has asked for: an annotated dataflow ledger (Art. 30 style) with timestamped extracts, a current subprocessor manifest, and a short DPIA mapping that explains where Redwood is processing MedNet personal data and the legal bases.

Specifically they want:
- CSV extract of the processing ledger containing timestamps and processing purpose tags
- Confirmation of active subprocessors with onboarding dates and country of processing
- KMS wrap details for exported logs (high-level: KMS provider, wrap keys used, last rotation)
- Example export lines for audit logs (redacted is fine, but must include event type and timestamp)

Can Redwood provide a scoped evidence packet or a short roadmap for delivery? We may need limited remote access to logs under a mutual NDA — please flag if that requires a separate process.

Happy to do a 30-minute call this week to scope.

Thanks,
Sarah Tucker
Head of Privacy & Compliance
MedNet Health

---
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tucker <sarah.tucker@mednet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPIA support + Art 28/30 ledger extracts

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list.

We can support the items you listed. Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Quick scoping call (30 min) to confirm sample sizes and redaction requirements. We have availability Thu 11/26 10:00am PT or Fri 11/27 2:00pm PT — which works for you?
2) We will prepare an initial evidence packet: subprocessor manifest (CSV), an annotated ledger extract (CSV) covering the last 6 months, and a short DPIA mapping (PDF).
3) For audit log exports / KMS attestation, our security team will prepare redacted log lines and a short KMS summary. If MedNet requires on-demand access we can discuss the access model (SFTP or encrypted Drive + temporary credentials) and an NDA/MAA.

Marissa and Irene — looping you for timeline and whether we can meet the Dec 7 review window.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Contract & Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tucker <sarah.tucker@mednet.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Draft evidence plan and preliminary attachments

Sarah / Chloe,

Thanks — outlined a delivery plan below and attached a first-pass subprocessor manifest (stubbed fields). Attachment notes: the CSV is a manifest export, not the full procurement docs.

Delivery plan (target timelines):
- T+1 business day: deliver subprocessor_manifest_v2.csv (attached) + high-level DPA/addendum draft for signature points.
- T+3 business days: provide annotated ledger extract (CSV) with processing purpose tags and timestamps. We will mark any PII in ledger rows for redaction guidance prior to export.
- T+5 business days: supply KMS summary + sample redacted export lines.

Format & transfer: encrypted ZIP placed on a shared Drive link (we can also do SFTP if you prefer). If the auditor will need interactive log queries we will require an MAA/NDA; DocuSign link will be prepared if you confirm.

Attachments:
- subprocessor_manifest_v2.csv (columns: subprocessor_name, country_of_processing, onboarding_date, role, contact)
- kafka-dataflow-diagram.png (high-level flow; no PII)
- dpa-addendum-draft.docx (template addendum with Art. 28/30 references)

Please confirm acceptance of the plan and whether MedNet has a preferred delivery method (Drive vs SFTP) and redaction policy (hashed ids ok?).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Privacy Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tucker <sarah.tucker@mednet.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft evidence plan and preliminary attachments

Sarah — following up with the detailed evidence roadmap and a short note on what we will include in each artifact. Forwarding the flow diagram as well for context.

Planned artifacts (example contents):
1) Annotated processing ledger (CSV)
   - fields: ledger_id, timestamp_utc, operation_type, data_categories, processing_purpose, legal_basis_tag, processing_location_country, retention_bucket
   - sample: we will include 50 sampling rows from the last 6 months; all personal identifiers will be pseudonymized (hashes).

2) Subprocessor manifest (CSV)
   - fields: subprocessor_name, role, onboarding_date(ISO), termination_date(if applicable), jurisdictions, contract_reference(DevID), SOC2_status

3) KMS & export attestation (PDF)
   - high-level: KMS provider, key rotation cadence, wrap method, last rotation date. We will not provide key material.

4) Log export samples (TXT)
   - redacted export lines containing: event_id, event_type, timestamp_utc, resource, outcome
   - we will remove usernames and IPs; we can include production resource prefixes to show scope.

Access model:
- We can place artifacts on an encrypted Drive link (short-lived) or push an encrypted SFTP bundle. For auditors needing remote-query access, we require a signed MAA/NDA and a scoped account — please indicate if you will request that.

Data handling constraints:
- We will not expose raw PII in the ledger. If MedNet requires raw identifiers for re-identification by your auditor, that must be done in MedNet-controlled infrastructure under a joint access plan.

Timeline check: the Dec 7 review is tight but feasible if we get confirmation on the redaction policy today. With approval we will deliver the first artifacts by EOD Wed 12/1 (subprocessor CSV + ledger sampling plan) and the remaining artifacts by 12/3.

Forwarded: kafka-dataflow-diagram.png (attached)

Regards,
Irene Choi
Privacy Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference
